messages:
Ivy: customer reported double billing when a stream falls back during an in-flight toolcall. repro attached.
Sam: TL;DR: model A starts a toolcall, router falls back to model B, both emit final -> two charges.
Diego: do we have anything to dedupe on? session id? request id?
Ivy: streaming currently doesn't inject a stable stream_session_id across handoffs. non-streaming toolcalls use client_request_id.
Sam: quick fixes: 1) router injects stream_session_id at session start and propagate to handlers; billing dedupes on (customer, stream_session_id, toolcall_hash). 2) short-term: billing-proxy provisionalize finals seen within 1s of another identical final using a small TTL cache.
Diego: agree. also add trace tags: fallback=true and fallback_reason so we can query impacted traces.
billing-bot: Alert BILL-3020 created: deduped_toolcall_fallbacks > 0.1% on prod for the last 20m.
Ivy: effort estimate: router change + header plumbing ~1.5d, handler libs update ~1d, billing-proxy dedupe/provisional path + tests ~2d, console metric + runbook ~0.5d.
Sam: tests: unit for dedupe, e2e sim of handler A killed mid-final, assert single confirmed charge. chaos test as follow-up.
Diego: canary: 3% traffic for router with session_id + provisional billing-proxy; monitor BILL-3020 and invoice delta for 1h. rollback via feature flag.
Ivy: i'll write RFC and open PRs. adding reconcile job to match late finals by session_id for historical cleanup.
Sam: thanks. :thumbsup:
